query: What drives customer satisfaction (Overall Rating) across the different airlines?

per_column.name: cabin_crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: A qualitative assessment of crew service, extractable from review text and distinct from the numeric overall rating; service quality plausibly drives satisfaction without being a component of the rating itself. Overlaps somewhat with existing Staff Service column but adds granularity.

per_column.name: ground_staff_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Ground/airport service is a distinct dimension not captured by inflight columns; a legitimate external driver of overall satisfaction with predictive signal.

per_column.name: service_consistency
per_column.rationale: Characterizes whether service was uniform vs. variable across the flight/legs; a plausible driver of satisfaction, not a deterministic function of the rating.

per_column.name: flight_disruption_type
per_column.rationale: Delays, cancellations, missed connections are external operational events strongly predictive of satisfaction and not restatements of the rating.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: How disruptions were handled is a distinct driver of satisfaction beyond whether a disruption occurred; legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: food_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: A qualitative food judgment; overlaps with existing Food & Beverages numeric column so marginal novelty is limited, but semantically it is a driver, not a restatement of overall rating.

per_column.name: special_meal_handling
per_column.rationale: Whether special meal requests were handled is an external service event that could affect satisfaction; legitimate though sparse (only 26 true), so weak signal.

per_column.name: seat_product_downgrade
per_column.rationale: A downgrade is an external adverse event plausibly driving lower satisfaction; legitimate predictor, though very sparse (23 true).

per_column.name: customer_service_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Responsiveness/resolution of customer service contact is a distinct driver of satisfaction, not a restatement or leak of the rating.

judge.rationale: All nine columns are legitimate external drivers of overall satisfaction, derived from review content rather than restating or leaking the numeric overall rating. They cover meaningful distinct dimensions (crew, ground staff, consistency, disruptions and their handling, food, special meals, downgrades, responsiveness) with plausible predictive signal. Deductions: a couple (food_quality_assessment, cabin_crew_service_quality) partially duplicate existing numeric sub-rating columns and so add limited incremental leverage, and two binary features are very sparse (~2-3% positive), limiting their contribution. As a set they still provide substantial genuine predictive value beyond the original columns.
